title: Narrow the store-copy functions to the crate, or refuse to delete a non-empty log when settling a copy
outcome: Narrow the store-copy functions to the crate, or refuse to delete a non-empty log when settling a copy
acceptance: SqliteStore::verify_store_copy and SqliteStore::copy_existing_read_only are not public outside the crate, or verify_store_copy refuses to remove a -wal sidecar that is not empty; a test in the repository shows the chosen guard

completion.summary: Restricted copying and settling store copies to the crate, kept verify_store_copy absent, documented owned private verified staging for the public installer, and added two passing external-call compile-fail doctests. Full gate, clean independent pair and fresh independent acceptance passed. Committed, installed and pushed under Fable window; four live stores ready.
